about_the_game:
Embark into Midnight Riff a casual rhythm adventure where you have to keep up and jam out to face the creatures that you meet along the way.

Featuring a unique battle system incorporating dynamic, looped charts that allow the player to add notes that can defeat your enemies or lead to your own doom. Made for rhythm game regulars and roguelike enjoyers alike.

Releasing soon for free!

Features

  • Jam out and place your own notes on the chart to outplay the creatures that impede your progress.

  • Collect powerful relics to aid your journey and turn the tide of battle.

  • Changing maps every playthrough to allow endless replayability.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Debian based distro from within the past few years
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu (latest release)
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Unlike anything seen before, Midnight Riff is a true rhythm roguelike. Vibe to the rhythm and jam out to deal damage and win battles with the unique active-time rhythm battle system. Can you become the rhythm of the night?
